newsitem.title: USA: Munsingwear completes sale to Supreme Intl.
newsitem.headline: Munsingwear completes sale to Supreme Intl.

text.p: Munsingwear Inc said shareholders on Friday approved an agreement to sell its domestic and certain international trademarks and brands and its branded retail and golf knit shirt business to Supreme International Corp.
It said Miami-based Supreme paid $18 million.
As part of the transaction, Munsingwear has changed its name to "Premium Wear Inc" and its trading symbol will become "PWA" on the New York Stock Exchange effective September 12.
Munsingwear also said Lowell Fisher will leave Monday as chief executive officer.

It said chairman Thomas Gleason will assume the CEO position on an interim basis. Fisher will leave to concentrate on his consulting company. The sale to Supreme International is another step in the company's progress to improving shareholder value, Gleason said.

"As indicated in our proxy, we expect to pay a dividend of at least $12 million in the next 180 days. This sale also provides capital to continue the profitable expansion of our Premium and Special Markets business, which has reached an annual sales volume of $25 million in just three years," he said. -- Chicago newsdesk 312 408-8787
